AI firm Anthropic seeks human writer for $345,000 role

Artificial intelligence company Anthropic has advertised a job for a human writer with a salary of $345,000 (approximately ₹3.26 crore). The role requires at least eight years of experience, the ability to quickly understand technical concepts, refine executive thinking, and remain calm during breaking news events. Experts suggest this position highlights the value placed on human judgment in the field of artificial intelligence.
